name: Home Assistant & Music Assistant
description:
Home Assistant: entity values and controls right in the top bar (switches, buttons, scrollable numbers, selectors, text entries; entity name on hover), menu controls picked automatically by domain, and an Assist chat using your preferred pipeline.
Music Assistant: player control in the menu (player, seek, volume, AI Radio DJ) and an MPRIS bridge for media keys and the native GNOME media controls.
